neighbours.label: The piece 'ett' of Rett (Rett syndrome, Andreas Rett); other eponymous syndromes stay quiet
fire: Girls with Rett syndrome lose hand skills early.
The gene for Rett was found in 1999.
Andreas Rett first described it in Vienna.
A mutation causes Rett syndrome in most patients.
The charity funds research into Rett syndrome each year.
Her daughter was diagnosed with Rett at two.
Doctors suspected Rett after she stopped talking.
Treatment for Rett syndrome is still limited.
quiet: Girls with Turner syndrome lose hand skills early.
The gene for Marfan was found in 1991.
Andreas Vesalius first described it in Vienna.
A mutation causes Leigh syndrome in most patients.
The charity funds research into Down syndrome each year.
Her daughter was diagnosed with autism at two.
Doctors suspected epilepsy after she stopped talking.
Treatment for fragile X syndrome is still limited.

notes: Card: ' X' x5 of fragile X, 'ett' x3, ' Leigh', ' eight'. Probe: 'ett' 0.84 in Rett syndrome, 0.46 in 'a girl named Rett'; fragile X 0.02, Leigh 0.02, Down 0.07. I expected a neurogenetic-syndrome label, and the probes do not support it; only the 'ett' piece holds, and the name alone fires it.
